command:
cd /Users/vincentdeboer/vscode/vcjdeboer.github.io
git init -b main >/dev/null 2>&1
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# vcjdeboer.github.io

Personal site — https://vcjdeboer.github.io

Recipes for restless robots, receipts for challenged mitochondria,
regressions for noisy physiology.
EOF
git add index.html README.md
git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Personal landing page

Editorial front door: intro, contact rows, and cards to the writing
(Press Play) and the Odyssey PyLabRobot talk.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
gh repo create vcjdeboer/vcjdeboer.github.io --public --source=. --remote=origin --push \
  --description "Personal site" 2>&1
echo "=== exit: $? ==="

for r in press-play vcjdeboer.github.io; do
  echo "=== enabling Pages: $r ==="
  gh api -X POST "repos/vcjdeboer/$r/pages" \
    -f "source[branch]=main" -f "source[path]=/" 2>&1 | head -20
  echo
done

check() {
  url="$1"; needle="$2"
  for i in $(seq 1 12); do
    body=$(curl -s "$url?cb=$i")
    if echo "$body" | grep -q "$needle"; then echo "LIVE: $url"; return 0; fi
    sleep 12
  done
  echo "NOT YET: $url (Pages still building)"; return 1
}
check "https://vcjdeboer.github.io/" "noisy physiology"
check "https://vcjdeboer.github.io/press-play/" "Press Play\|Press Play"

for u in \
  "https://vcjdeboer.github.io/press-play/" \
  "https://vcjdeboer.github.io/odyssey-plr-presentation/" \
  "https://github.com/vcjdeboer/session-suite" \
  "https://github.com/vcjdeboer/session-ingest" \
  "https://swamp-club.com" \
  "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9928-1698" \
  "https://github.com/vcjdeboer" ; do
  printf "%-55s " "$u"
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -L "$u"
done
